blocks.text: The burial galleries of drowned Maro, sealed since [[The Drowning War]]. The entrance below the Lantern Shrine in [[Port Vellen]] is bricked up and warded — officially, no one has been inside for forty years.

Officially. The outer galleries are a smuggler den reachable by the tunnel behind the fish market. The inner seal still holds — it can only be opened by [[The Hollow Crown]], which is why [[The Veiled Hand]] is tearing the Reach apart looking for it.
Room 1 is the entrance gallery. The pit trap before the double doors resets itself — that's not clockwork, that's the crypt *wanting* it armed.
The floor tiles by the east door hide a pit. Anyone who searches the room finds the seam; a fall is 2d6 damage and drops into the flooded ossuary below.
[[Kestrel Vane]]’s smugglers keep their stock here: three crates of lamp oil and a locked strongbox. The key hangs in the Harbor Office.
